items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: you see Burt Lancaster in an early movie where he’s eating with his fork

ctx.x: Oh yeah, improvising. No I never thought of anything like that. It was just like I called around to different people and I said, “Gee I’m in this movie, what should I do?” And I called Med Flory and he was very, he was the only one that gave me good advice. He said, “Just remember they’re going to shoot the scene from different angles, just try to remember what your hands are doing when you’re saying certain things, and try to do it the same way. And that was the best advice I got. You know like, so after that I…
